ideas.title: Minnesota's Efforts to Combat Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate Minnesota's efforts to combat Medicaid fraud, including the recruitment of state employees for site checks and the impact on high-risk services.
questions: What are the results of Minnesota's efforts to combat Medicaid fraud?
How effective are site checks in preventing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the effectiveness of Minnesota's efforts to combat Medicaid fraud and the impact on high-risk services.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Hudson Tunnel Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the Hudson Tunnel funding freeze on infrastructure projects and the lawsuits resulting from it.
questions: What is the estimated cost of the Hudson Tunnel project?
How many jobs will be impacted by the funding freeze?
